desc: Drill EXCAVATE mines ACROSS a void (ravine-bisected vein). The drill reaches ore #1 (DRILL_VEIN_REACHED), then EXCAVATE strip-mines the vein box — but that box spans a 5-wide gap (x=3..5), so its serpentine plan (pure geometry, terrain-blind) emits stand-cells hanging over open air. The void guard used to prune every such cell (EXCAVATE_VOID_SKIP), losing the far side of the band; now, with filler in the bag + cfg.nav.bridge, it falls through to the dig/step path and greedy BRIDGES into the band across the gap (EXCAVATE_VOID_BRIDGE → PLACE_CELL lays the deck). Skip remains only the no-filler fallback (covered offline in drill-mission.test.ts). Setup: bot descends shaft x=0 → horizon scan sees ore #1 at (2,101) → mines it, lands on stable stone (support (2,100) stays). The vein box spans the gap to ore #2 at (6,100) on the far rim; corridor cells over x=3..5 hang over the pit. The bot carries 64 cobblestone → the void guard keeps those cells, greedy lays filler across from stable footing, and the far-side ore gets mined. CATCH-FLOOR y=95 spans the FULL excavate box footprint (z -5..3 — the serpentine corridor runs rows out to z=-4, wider than the seeded vein line) so a bridge miss anywhere is a survivable fall onto stone, not a drop past the slab onto real terrain. Success = DRILL_VEIN_REACHED + EXCAVATE_VOID_BRIDGE + PLACE_CELL, no ERROR.
